title: Agent Recovery Gone Wrong: Measuring Harm Beyond Duplicate Calls
abstract: arXiv:2611.31554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code-executing LLM agents submit blocks of code that issue several API writes. If a block fails after some of its writes have taken effect, the agent rewrites the block and continues. It is unknown how often such a recovery harms the external state when the failure occurs naturally in the code written by the agent. In this paper, we measure it on recorded trajectories of AppWorld agents. In a stratified random sample of 200 candidate episodes across ten models, 145 are partial executions confirmed by the database state. In the sample, 30 of 143 confirmed partial executions with a determinable outcome are followed by a harmful recovery, and its violation remains at the end of the run, which gives a stratification-weighted estimate of 24.6%. Two thirds of the harmful recoveries duplicate an effect, and the rest delete user data or make a wrong first-time write, e.g., an order of a wrong product. translated_title: 智能体恢复出错：测量重复调用之外的危害
translated_abstract: 执行代码的大语言模型智能体会提交包含多个API写操作的代码块。如果某个代码块在其部分写操作已生效之后失败，智能体会重写该代码块并继续执行。当这种失败在智能体自己编写的代码中自然发生时，此类恢复在多大频率上会危害外部状态，目前尚不清楚。本文在AppWorld智能体的记录轨迹上对此进行了测量。在对十个模型的200个候选回合进行的分层随机抽样中，有145个被数据库状态确认为部分执行。在样本中，143个结果可确定的确认部分执行里有30个随后发生了有害恢复，且其违规状态在运行结束时仍然存在，由此得到分层加权估计值为24.6%。三分之二的有害恢复表现为重复了某个效果，其余的则删除用户数据或进行错误的首次写入，例如订购了错误的产品。搜索重复调用的规则发现……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次在自然发生的失败场景下量化了代码执行型LLM智能体恢复操作对外部状态的危害，发现约24.6%的结果可确定的部分执行会导致在运行结束时仍持续存在的有害恢复，其中仅三分之二表现为重复调用，其余则表现为删除用户数据或错误的首次写入，说明仅检测重复调用不足以捕捉全部危害。
en_tdlr: This paper measures harm to external state caused by recovery in code-executing LLM agents after naturally occurring partial-execution failures, finding that 24.6% of determinable-outcome partial executions lead to harmful recoveries that persist at run end—with only two-thirds manifesting as duplicate effects and the rest deleting user data or making wrong first-time writes—showing that duplicate-call detection alone misses much of the harm.
